general.body: It is a conversation, not a quiz. Long, natural answers score higher than perfect short ones.
If you do not understand, ask: 'Could you repeat the question, please?' It costs nothing.
In Part 2, use all four bullet points as your plan and keep talking until the examiner stops you.
Pronunciation is a quarter of your score. Speak clearly at a steady pace, not fast.

beginner.body: Answer + reason + example. For example: 'I live in an apartment, because it is close to my work. For example, I can walk there in ten minutes.'

intermediate.body: Extend every answer with 'because' and a short example. Don't memorise answers; examiners notice.

advanced.body: Use a range of tenses and some less common phrases naturally, like 'to be honest' or 'it depends on'.

professional.body: Show flexibility: speculate, contrast and concede ('Admittedly…, but…'). Keep it natural, not rehearsed.
